title: Kontoor Brands Announces Second Quarter 2026 Earnings and Conference Call Date
body_text: Kontoor Brands Announces Second Quarter 2026 Earnings and Conference Call Date Download as PDF July 22, 2026 6:50am EDT GREENSBORO, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Kontoor Brands, Inc. (NYSE: KTB) today announced plans to release its second quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, at approximately 6:50 a.m. ET. Following the news release, Kontoor management will host a conference call at approximately 8:30 a.m. ET to review results. The conference call will be broadcast live and accessible at kontoorbrands.com/investors . For those unable to listen to the live broadcast, an archived version will be available at the same location. About Kontoor Brands Kontoor Brands, Inc. Kontoor Brands is a purpose-led organization focused on leveraging its global platform, strategic sourcing model and best-in-class supply chain to drive brand growth and deliver long-term value for its stakeholders. For more information about Kontoor Brands, please visit www.KontoorBrands.com . title: Understanding 'Under Contract' vs. 'Pending' in Real Estate
summary: Learn the difference between “under contract” and “pending” in real estate. Understand what each status means, how they impact buyers and sellers, and what happens at each stage of the sale process.
body_text: ❓What does 'under contract' mean in real estate? In real estate , the term "under contract" signifies that a seller has accepted a buyer's offer, and both parties have signed a purchase agreement. However, this agreement is typically contingent upon certain conditions being met before the sale is finalized. These conditions, known as contingencies, can include home inspections, financing approvals, appraisals, or the sale of the buyer's current home. During this phase, the property is still technically on the market, and the seller may accept backup offers. This status indicates that while the initial steps toward a sale have been taken, there are still hurdles to clear. The buyer and seller must work through these contingencies, and if any are not satisfied, the deal can fall through. It's important for both buyers and sellers to understand that being "under contract" does not guarantee a sale. The process requires careful navigation of the agreed-upon terms, and until all contingencies are resolved, the property remains in a state of limbo. This stage is crucial for due diligence, allowing both parties to ensure that the transaction proceeds smoothly and in accordance with the agreed terms. ❓What does 'pending' mean in real estate? The term "pending" in real estate indicates that all contingencies outlined in the purchase agreement have been met, and the transaction is in its final stages before closing. At this point, the buyer and seller have fulfilled their respective obligations, such as completing inspections, securing financing, and agreeing on any necessary repairs. Once a property is marked as pending, it is typically removed from the market, and no further offers are entertained. This status reflects a high level of commitment from both parties, signaling that the sale is imminent. However, it's worth noting that, although rare, deals can still fall through during this phase due to unforeseen circumstances, such as last-minute financing issues or changes in buyer or seller circumstances. For prospective buyers, a pending status usually means the opportunity to purchase that particular property has passed. For sellers, reaching the pending stage is a positive sign that the transaction is nearing completion. It's a period of anticipation and preparation for the final steps of the real estate transaction, culminating in the transfer of ownership. ❓How do 'under contract' and 'pending' statuses differ? While both "under contract" and "pending" indicate that a property is in the process of being sold, they represent different stages within that process. Understanding the distinction between these terms is essential for buyers and sellers navigating the real estate market. "Under contract" refers to the initial phase after a seller has accepted a buyer's offer, but before all contingencies have been satisfied. During this time, the sale is not guaranteed, as various conditions must be met. The property may still be shown to other potential buyers, and backup offers can be submitted. In contrast, "pending" signifies that all contingencies have been addressed, and the sale is moving toward closing. At this stage, the property is typically taken off the market, and no additional offers are considered. The likelihood of the sale falling through is significantly lower compared to the "under contract" phase. In summary, "under contract" is an earlier stage where the sale is conditional, while "pending" indicates that the transaction is nearing completion, with all conditions met. Recognizing these differences helps manage expectations and informs decision-making for all parties involved. ❓Can a deal fall through when a property is under contract or pending? Yes, real estate deals can fall through during both the "under contract" and "pending" stages, although the likelihood varies between the two. Understanding the potential pitfalls at each stage is crucial for buyers and sellers. During the "under contract" phase, deals are more susceptible to falling apart due to unmet contingencies. Common reasons include: Financing Issues : The buyer may fail to secure a mortgage. Inspection Problems : Unforeseen issues discovered during the home inspection can lead to renegotiations or cancellations. Appraisal Discrepancies : If the property's appraised value is lower than the agreed-upon price, financing may be affected. Title Complications : Legal issues with the property's title can delay or derail the sale. In the "pending" stage, most contingencies have been resolved, reducing the risk of the deal collapsing. However, unexpected events can still occur, such as: Job Loss : The buyer loses employment, affecting their ability to secure financing. Personal Circumstances : Changes in personal situations may lead to withdrawal from the deal. While the "pending" status offers more assurance, it's not an absolute guarantee of sale completion. Both buyers and sellers should remain vigilant and prepared for potential challenges until the transaction is officially closed. ❓Can buyers submit offers on properties that are under contract or pending? Yes, buyers can submit offers on properties that are under contract, and in some cases, even on those that are pending. However, the likelihood of the seller considering these offers varies depending on the property's status. For properties "under contract," sellers may accept backup offers. These are secondary offers that the seller can consider if the primary deal falls through due to unmet contingencies or other issues. Submitting a backup offer can position a buyer favorably should the initial transaction not proceed to closing. When a property is "pending," it typically means all contingencies have been satisfied, and the sale is nearing completion. In this stage, sellers are less likely to entertain new offers. However, it's not entirely out of the question. Some sellers may accept backup offers as a precaution against unforeseen complications that could jeopardize the pending sale. Buyers interested in such properties should communicate with their real estate agents to understand the specific circumstances and determine the best course of action. While the chances may be slim, being proactive can sometimes lead to unexpected opportunities in the dynamic real estate market. ❓How can buyers and sellers navigate the 'under contract' and 'pending' stages effectively? Navigating the "under contract" and "pending" stages requires diligence, communication, and preparation from both buyers and sellers to ensure a smooth transaction. For Buyers: Stay Informed : Regularly communicate with your real estate agent to stay updated on the progress of contingencies and any potential issues. Fulfill Obligations Promptly : Complete necessary inspections, secure financing, and provide required documentation within agreed timelines. Be Prepared for Contingencies : Understand the terms of your contingencies and be ready to negotiate or address any findings from inspections or appraisals. For Sellers: Maintain Transparency : Provide accurate information about the property's condition and any known issues to prevent surprises during inspections. Stay Engaged : Keep in touch with your agent and be responsive to requests for information or access to the property. Consider Backup Offers : Evaluate the benefits of accepting backup offers, especially during the "under contract" phase, to mitigate risks if the primary deal falls through. Both parties should work closely with their real estate professionals to navigate these stages effectively. Clear communication, adherence to timelines, and proactive problem-solving are key to transitioning from "under contract" to a successful closing. See what else we're writing about on the ROGER Blog

title: NEW JERSEY NATURAL GAS HOSTED ENERGY ASSISTANCE CONFERENCE FOR LOCAL NONPROFITS
summary: Provides Overview of Programs and Resources Available for Community Members
body_text: New Jersey Natural Gas NEW JERSEY NATURAL GAS HOSTED ENERGY ASSISTANCE CONFERENCE FOR LOCAL NONPROFITS 03/08/2024 - For Immediate Release WALL, N.J. - New Jersey Natural Gas (NJNG), the principal subsidiary of New Jersey Resources (NYSE: NJR), recently hosted an Energy Assistance Conference to educate local nonprofits and municipalities on energy assistance programs, including direct grants, as well as home energy-efficiency and weatherization opportunities for low- and moderate-income households. The conference was designed to ensure front-line organizations are fully equipped with the information and resources required to best support community members when addressing their energy needs. The event provided the latest updates on the: 2024 heating season Federally funded Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program State-funded Universal Service Fund The New Jersey Board of Public Utilities’ Payment Assistance for Gas & Electric Program New Jersey SHARES NJNG’s Gift of Warmth New Jersey Comfort Partners Program NJNG’s Home Weatherization Program And more “Making sure nonprofits and local government professionals know about available programs is an important step to helping community members connect with and benefit from these vital resources,” said Maria Delaplain, manager of Energy Assistance at New Jersey Natural Gas. “Our goal is to ensure that residents in our service territory have multiple points of access to much-needed programs to help pay and lower their energy bills. These organizations and agencies are often the first point of contact to help customers get the assistance they need,” Delaplain continued. Beginning March 22, 2024, NJNG will provide on-site payment assistance at its payment centers in Asbury Park and Lakewood from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. on select days. Customers who may be experiencing financial hardship are encouraged to stop by. Local community agencies also will be available to help customers with program eligibility and the application process. Representatives from the Community Affairs and Resource Center (CARC) will at NJNG’s Asbury Park Payment Center, located at 633 Lake Avenue, on the following days: March 22 and 29 April 5, 12, 19 and 26 May 3, 10, 17, 24 and 31 June 7, 14, 21 and 28 Affordable Housing Alliance will be at NJNG’s Asbury Park Payment Center on: March 25 April 1, 8, 15, 22 and 29 May 6, 13 and 20 June 3, 10, 17 and 24 CARC and OCEAN Inc. will be at NJNG’s Lakewood Payment Center, located at 775 Vassar Avenue, on: March 25 April 12 May 10 June 17 For more information, visit njng.com/energyassistance or contact 800-221-0051 and say “energy assistance” at the prompt. About New Jersey Resources New Jersey Resources (NYSE: NJR) is a Fortune 1000 company that, through its subsidiaries, provides safe and reliable natural gas and clean energy services, including transportation, distribution, asset management and home services. NJR is composed of five primary businesses: New Jersey Natural Gas , NJR’s principal subsidiary, operates and maintains natural gas transportation and distribution infrastructure to serve nearly 580,000 customers in New Jersey’s Monmouth, Ocean and parts of Morris, Middlesex, Sussex and Burlington counties. Clean Energy Ventures invests in, owns and operates solar projects with a total capacity of approximately 473 megawatts, providing residential and commercial customers with low-carbon solutions. Energy Services manages a diversified portfolio of natural gas transportation and storage assets and provides physical natural gas services and customized energy solutions to its customers across North America. Storage and Transportation serves customers from local distributors and producers to electric generators and wholesale marketers through its ownership of Leaf River Energy Center and the Adelphia Gateway Pipeline, as well as our 50% equity ownership in the Steckman Ridge natural gas storage facility. Home Services provides service contracts as well as heating, central air conditioning, water heaters, standby generators, solar and other indoor and outdoor comfort products to residential homes throughout New Jersey. NJR and its over 1,300 employees are committed to helping customers save energy and money by promoting conservation and encouraging efficiency through Conserve to Preserve® and initiatives such as SAVEGREEN™ and The Sunlight Advantage®. For more information about NJR: www.njresources.com Follow us on X (formerly Twitter) @NJNaturalGas . “Like” us on facebook.com/NewJerseyNaturalGas . title: Vertiv Launches Partner Program for Latin America Distributors
summary: Vertiv announced the launch of the Vertiv Partner Program designed to empower distributors and resellers to meet the complex customer demands around edge computing, digitalization and other disruptive trends facing today’s data center and wider IT landscape.
body_text: Sunrise, FL [April 25, 2019] – Vertiv today announced the launch of the Vertiv Partner Program designed to empower distributors and resellers to meet the complex customer demands around edge computing, digitalization and other disruptive trends facing today’s data center and wider IT landscape. The Vertiv Partner Program will facilitate the sales and marketing of Vertiv digital infrastructure products and services for the company’s growing eco-system of partners across the Latin America region. Through the Vertiv Partner Portal , partners will have access to sales and marketing tools that will allow them to grow their businesses and remain competitive. Key features include: Vertiv University : A cloud-based learning tool providing “Edge Solutions Partner” channel certification. A Deal Registration Tool: Authorized partners can protect their investment in finding and developing a project. A Marketing Automation Tool: Vertiv provides partner-personalized syndicated web content, web banners and collateral material to enhance their marketing efforts. A Product Selector: Creates Vertiv online product content for deployment to a partner website, facilitating ecommerce. Access to Co-op Funds: Partners who reach Platinum and Diamond status may earn funds to assist with key marketing and/or business-related initiatives. Partner levels begin at Solution Provider and escalate through levels up to Solution Provider Platinum and Solution Provider Diamond, based on sales volumes. Vertiv One : Partners can earn points for selecting and selling Vertiv products. They can redeem these points toward merchandise, digital vouchers, a digital Visa card and gift cards. Additionally, partners will gain access to a dedicated team of sales and technical specialists to assist at every stage of the sales cycle. “What sets Vertiv apart is our extensive offerings and broad and deep understanding of the modern data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities that enable the vital applications we depend on 24/7. We want to bring this expertise and access to our growing network of partners in the region,” said Ricardo Duque, who was recently named Vertiv’s vice president of channel strategies for the Americas. Duque previously held the position of vice president for the Latin American Channel at Vertiv. Over the past year, Vertiv has invested in ongoing, in-depth research to define four main edge computing archetypes and identify the most mature cases to be enabled by 5G , which will present the clearest and immediate commercial opportunities for its ecosystem of partners. “Vertiv is committed to working closely with our partners to help satisfy the demands of their customers resulting from disruptive technology. Their success is our success,” adds Duque. In addition to tools and incentives to help resellers succeed, Vertiv is continuing to add to its dedicated channel portfolio consisting of products and services for critical power management, thermal management, infrastructure monitoring, IT management, integrated solutions, racks and rack power distribution units. For more information about Vertiv, visit Vertiv.com or find us on social media: Facebook, LinkedIn , and Twitter . About Vertiv Vertiv brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to ensure its customers’ vital applications run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extends from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 20,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. For more information, and for the latest news and content from Vertiv, visit Vertiv.com . CONTACT Ivis C. Fernandez P 305-335-5883 E Ivis@fusioncomminc.com

title: Bluedot Blog | The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Enhancing EV Performance
body_text: During the era of technological advancements, the automotive industry is on the brink of revolution, mainly caused by Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its implementation in the segment of electric vehicles (EVs). This fusion of artificial intelligence and EVs is not only revolutionizing how we see car movement but is dramatically increasing EV performance, making sustainable mobility much more available and effective than ever. Enhanced Battery Management and Optimization for Extended EV Range with AI At the heart of an electric vehicle's (EV) capabilities lies the battery, determining its range and performance. Using Artificial Intelligence, EV battery management , and optimization are changed into a transformative shift. Employing intricate algorithms and machine learning, AI improves battery usage to the slightest detail, widening the potential of the EV range. This involves predictive analytics of battery life, optimizing charging cycles, and dynamically adjusting energy consumption depending on driving behaviors. This smart management makes electric vehicles work with unprecedented performance, a huge step in sustainable transportation. AI's Role in Pioneering Autonomous Electric Vehicle Development The dream of completely autonomous vehicles is slowly being transformed into reality due to the progressive developments in AI. AI is very important in shaping the future of self-driving technology within the electric vehicle sector. AI helps EVs to navigate complex surroundings through the instant processing of lots of data from sensors and cameras. This development goes beyond just convenience since it provides an opportunity to decrease road accidents provoked by human mistakes and create prerequisites for safer transport in the future. Optimizing EV Charging Efficiency through AI Technologies Proper charging is necessary for the operational sustainability and longevity of the electric vehicle. In this regard, AI is revolutionizing this area by improving the effectiveness of charging processes. AI optimizes charging schedules and station utilization by utilizing real-time analysis of grid conditions and adjusting to user preferences. This smart practice guarantees electric vehicle charging is done at night, reducing costs and maximizing energy utilization. In addition, AI also facilitates route planning, where the charging station locations are integrated to minimize range anxiety for electric vehicle (EV) users . AI-Driven Innovations in Traffic Management and EV Integration Electrified vehicles have been a welcome trend to city roadways, though these developments pose challenges to managing traffic and creating infrastructure. AI gives answers in the form of traffic data analysis to lead the way and eliminate the bottleneck that had congested the transport. This innovation normally means shorter and more energy-efficient routes for EV owners , thus providing better convenience to them. This also uses AI to ensure that EVs smoothly connect to the grid and balance power supply and demand, contributing to green cities. Artificial intelligence has different aspects as far as electric vehicle performance is concerned. These elements are also important and impact the transformation of electric vehicles. AI focuses on battery extension in this EV revolution , besides adopting intelligent driving systems, efficient charging, and fast adaptation. Continuously, AI and EV integration makes us hope to meet an eco-friendly dream instead of the smart and efficient world of transportation as we envision the relationship between these technologies.
